edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. Nothing in this Agreement prohibits lawful reporting to, or cooperation with, governmental or regulatory authorities.
edits.name: Confidentiality exceptions

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from [IDENTIFY ACTION OR DISPUTE, INCLUDING CASE CAPTION, COURT, AND CASE NUMBER IF APPLICABLE] (the “Dispute”).
edits.name: Define the Dispute

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) within 30 calendar days after the later of execution of this Agreement by both parties and Defendant’s receipt of verified wire instructions, by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated by Plaintiff in writing. Plaintiff shall promptly provide wire instructions following execution, and the parties shall cooperate promptly in verifying those instructions through independently confirmed contact information. Defendant shall not unreasonably delay verification. Payment is complete only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds.
edits.name: Payment timing and verification

edits.text: 2. RELEASE; STAY AND DISMISSAL. Effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims, known or unknown, arising from the Dispute through the date this Agreement is executed by both parties. This release does not extend to rights or obligations under this Agreement, including the right to enforce it. Upon execution, the parties shall promptly seek a stay of any pending proceedings concerning the Dispute pending timely payment and shall cooperate in obtaining any necessary court approval. Within three business days after Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, the parties shall file the papers necessary to dismiss those proceedings with prejudice, each bearing its own fees and costs in connection with the Dispute. If full payment is not timely received, the release shall not take effect, no dismissal shall be required, and Plaintiff may seek to lift the stay and pursue the underlying claims or enforce this Agreement, without double recovery.
edits.name: Payment-conditioned release and procedural steps
